Method of Attack: Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) providing access to a ransomware distribution network
Encrypts configured file types on Windows PCs using AES 256 encryption key
Creates ransom notes and boot-time banner messages demanding payment
Targets multiple file extensions but excludes executable files by default
Backend panel hosted on Tor hidden service for management and monitoring
Allows customization of ransom payment details and crypter usage
Attack Vector: Ransomware executable distributed via Dark Web RaaS portal
Indicators of Compromise: Dark Web URL indexing service listing
Ranion backend panel accessible via Tor .onion site
README ransom notes in multiple languages (eng, rus, ger, fra, esp, ita)
Ransom payment in Bitcoin (0.95 BTC/year or 0.6 BTC/6 months)
